hub.title: Operator resources
hub.lede: Use these field guides when a live problem calls for a deeper diagnostic, a worked case, or a reusable desk artifact. The block pages remain the canonical course path.

resources.title: The Install Fault Tree
resources.summary: A layered diagnostic for separating shell, path, runtime, identity/access, local-policy, and tool failures.
resources.useWhen: Use when an install or smoke test fails and the next move is unclear.
resources.artifact: The first failed boundary, one targeted correction, and a rerun of the affected smoke check.

resources.title: Fresh-Start Verification
resources.summary: A short check that separates durable workstation setup from temporary terminal, app, and output state.
resources.useWhen: Use when setup worked only after terminal changes, app restarts, or instructor help.
resources.artifact: Four freshly regenerated course smoke files after a safe restart.

resources.title: Metamorphic Tests for Generative Judgment Products
resources.summary: A practical test family for checking sensitivity, invariance, contradiction handling, and corruption response when no single oracle is enough.
resources.useWhen: Use when a generative product sounds plausible but exact expected output cannot be prewritten.
resources.artifact: A metamorphic test sheet with transformations, expected relations, and observed failures.

resources.title: Reproducible Runs: Stable IDs, Manifests, and Hashes
resources.summary: A run-evidence pattern that binds inputs, configuration, identity, and outputs into a replayable record.
resources.useWhen: Use when another operator must be able to reconstruct what produced a brief or verdict.
resources.artifact: A run manifest and replay checklist for one evidence-bearing product.

resources.title: Independence Is a Spectrum
resources.summary: A common-mode risk map for shared prompts, context, tools, data, infrastructure, and model ancestry.
resources.useWhen: Use before treating agreement between engines or reviewers as independent corroboration.
resources.artifact: An independence ledger with shared-state risks and isolation moves.

resources.title: Claim Lineage: One Rumor, Five Notes
resources.summary: A lineage exercise for detecting derivative evidence, circular sourcing, and false independence in linked knowledge.
resources.useWhen: Use when many notes appear to support a claim but may all descend from one report.
resources.artifact: A claim-lineage graph with source roots, transformations, and confidence corrections.

resources.title: Negative Knowledge and Honest Refusal
resources.summary: A practical method for representing unknown, disputed, withheld, stale, and not-yet-observed facts without filling gaps.
resources.useWhen: Use when a knowledge system is rewarded for answering even though the evidence cannot support an answer.
resources.artifact: A refusal and negative-knowledge schema tested against ambiguous questions.

resources.title: The Containment Evidence Ladder
resources.summary: A containment method that combines manifests, canaries, diffs, effect checks, and clean reruns to bound what an untrusted input affected.
resources.useWhen: Use when containment must be demonstrated from artifacts rather than asserted from instructions.
resources.artifact: A containment proof packet with manifests, canaries, diffs, reruns, and residual uncertainty.

resources.title: From Risk List to Contract: FMEA for Agent Work
resources.summary: A failure-mode analysis that turns severity, likelihood, detectability, ownership, evidence, and recovery into contract rows.
resources.useWhen: Use before autonomous work runs unattended or when a risk list has no enforceable owners.
resources.artifact: An FMEA-to-contract table with orphan risks exposed.

resources.title: The Human Factors of Supervising Autonomy
resources.summary: A supervision field guide for mode confusion, stop reluctance, alarm fatigue, exception overload, and skill decay.
resources.useWhen: Use when a technically bounded system still depends on a human noticing and acting at the right time.
resources.artifact: A supervision risk map and intervention rehearsal.

resources.title: The Machine-Choice Field Manual
resources.summary: A workload-sorting method using variability, volume, reversibility, latency, risk, and the value of human judgment.
resources.useWhen: Use before deciding whether work belongs in an agent loop, a gated pipeline, or human hands.
resources.artifact: A scored workload portfolio with routing reasons and revisit triggers.

resources.title: Human Gate Capacity and Exception Economics
resources.summary: A capacity and exception-economics method for arrivals, service rate, queue age, defaults, escalation, false holds, and misses.
resources.useWhen: Use after a correctly placed human gate exists and its exception lane must carry real work without hiding delay or error.
resources.artifact: A gate capacity model and exception packet specification.

resources.title: Know the Endpoint Trust Boundary
resources.summary: A trust-boundary map for credentials, transport, egress, logging, retention, provider access, and local control claims.
resources.useWhen: Use before sensitive work is pointed at a new model endpoint or hosting arrangement.
resources.artifact: An endpoint data-flow and trust-boundary record with unresolved questions made explicit.

resources.title: Capability Tax and Endpoint Portfolio
resources.summary: A portfolio method for routing work across endpoints by measured capability, risk, privacy, latency, cost, resilience, and acceptable degradation.
resources.useWhen: Use when one endpoint cannot honestly be the best home for every workload.
resources.artifact: A workload-to-endpoint routing matrix with hold-routing and bounded-degrade rules.

resources.title: Operator’s Pocket Card
resources.summary: A one-page field reference for specifying, building, checking, releasing, and handing off serious AI-assisted work.
resources.useWhen: Keep beside the keyboard during consequential AI-assisted work.
